name: w2-two-employers-excess-ss-additional-medicare
computation: Single filer, born 1982-11-02 (age 44 in 2026, not a senior, not blind, not a dependent). Line 9 total income = $215,000.00 (no interest, dividends or other income). Line 10 adjustments = $0.00. Line 11a/11b AGI = $215,000.00. Line 12e standard deduction: Rev. Line 17 AMT/repayments = $0.00. Line 18 income tax before credits = $40,334.00. Lines 19-21 credits = $0.00 (none claimed; no dependents, no clean-vehicle, no mortgage, education or care credits entered). Line 22 income tax after credits = $40,334.00. No self-employment income, so the Part II self-employment share is $0.00. Line 23 additional taxes = $135.00 (no self-employment tax, NIIT -- there is no interest, dividend or capital-gain investment income for the 3.8% base even though MAGI exceeds the threshold --, or other Schedule 2 Part II tax). Line 24a total tax = $40,334.00 + $135.00 = $40,469.00 (no Form 1062 farmland election). Line 25a W-2 federal income tax withheld = $20,000.00 + $14,000.00 = $34,000.00. Line 25d = $34,000.00 + $0.00 + $0.00 = $34,000.00. Line 26 estimated payments = $0.00.
